neighbours.label: the word piece that continues some rare names opening in Hu- (Hu|ila, H|ues|ca, H|ux|table), as opposed to rare names with another opening, even when they share the piece (Gu|iz|hou, R|uis|dael)

short: piece after Hu- in some rare names
notes: Card tops: Hue|h|uetenango, Hu|ap|ai, Hu|ic|ui, Hu|ah|ua, HU|AN|UNI, H|uis|man. Probes: 'ual', 'ich', 'uy', 'uis', 'uan' 0.46-0.96, 'ux' 0.33; Quetzaltenango, Tegucigalpa, Kahului, Hmong 0.04 or less. Not all Hu names fire: Hu|mberto 0.06, Hut|u 0.16, and Hu|iling peaked at ' Hu' 0.05. Single-token names such as ' Huang' or ' Hudson' are quiet. Pieces checked with the tokenizer.
